content.text: Clean eating is not a diet — it is a philosophy. The focus is on whole, minimally processed foods and eliminating refined sugars, artificial additives, and processed oils. This 7-day plan is built around real food that tastes great and fuels your body optimally.
Clean Eating Rules for This Plan

items: Eat whole, single-ingredient foods as much as possible
Avoid added sugars, artificial sweeteners, and refined grains
Choose lean proteins: chicken, fish, legumes, eggs
Include healthy fats: avocado, olive oil, nuts, seeds
Drink at least 8 glasses of water daily

content.text: Breakfast: Overnight oats with chia seeds, blueberries, and almond butter. Lunch: Large spinach salad with grilled chicken, avocado, cucumber, and lemon-tahini dressing. Snack: Apple with 2 tbsp almond butter. Dinner: Baked salmon with roasted broccoli and quinoa. Total: ~1,650 calories, 120g protein.
Prep your grains and proteins on Sunday to make weekday meals effortless. Store in glass containers for easy portion control.

items.question: How many calories is this clean eating plan?
items.answer: Each day averages 1,500–1,800 calories, which is appropriate for most adults seeking moderate weight loss or maintenance. Adjust portion sizes based on your individual calorie needs.

items.question: Can I swap foods in the meal plan?
items.answer: Yes. The plan is flexible. Swap proteins (e.g. replace chicken with tofu), swap grains (brown rice for quinoa), and swap vegetables freely. Keep portions similar to maintain macros.
